zotero.abstractNote: While open-ended (OE) AI offers significant potential, it poses unique and substantial risks that must be addressed for a safe and responsible deployment. Its inherent properties—such as continuous learning, self-modification, and long-term autonomy—create a dynamic environment where traditional safety measures may prove insufficient. In this position paper, we argue that the defining properties of OE AI systems introduce a distinct and underexplored class of safety challenges. We outline these challenges and propose a research agenda to ensure that safety is integrated into the development lifecycle of OE AI, rather than treated as an afterthought.
